## Material Brands Stocked & Installed

- **Pavers:** Techo-Bloc (Blu 60, Blu HD², Blu Grande, Sleek), Unilock (Beacon Hill, Umbriano, Richcliff), Permacon (Melville 60/80, Mega Melville), Oaks (Nueva, Rialto)
- **Natural stone:** Oakville Stone (Blue Ice, Black Limestone, Hampton), StoneArch (Silver Valley, Slate Gray, IndusGray)
- **Porcelain:** Porcea (Algonquin, Coast, Moongrey, Thundercloud) — 24x24 to 24x48 formats
- **Composite decking:** Trex (Enhance Naturals, Transcend Lineage), TimberTech (AZEK Prime+, AZEK Vintage)
- **Retaining wall systems:** Techo-Bloc Mini-Creta, Permacon Tandem, Unilock Estate Wall
- **Lighting:** In-Lite low-voltage systems (8–14 fixture residential standard)
- **Polymeric sand:** Techniseal HP NextGel (Urban Grey)
- **Aggregates / base:** Carr Landscape Depot (Barrie supplier) — 3/4" clear stone open-graded base, HPB bedding, A-Gravel

## The Engineering Standard

Golden Maple builds for the Ontario freeze-thaw cycle:

1. **Base depth:** 12–16 inches of excavation (industry standard is 6–8 inches). Twice as deep is what makes a 25-year patio vs. a 5-year one.
2. **Base material:** 3/4" clear stone (open-graded, drains under freeze-thaw) plus HPB (High Performance Bedding) for the 1" leveling layer. Not Granular A, which holds moisture and frost-heaves.
3. **Polymeric sand:** Techniseal HP NextGel for joint stabilization. Cured at temperatures above 0°C with 24-hour rain-free window.
4. **Edge restraint:** Snap Edge or Gator Edge X4 mechanically secured every ~12 inches.
5. **Geotextile fabric:** Always installed between sub-base and base for soil separation.
6. **ICPI-certified installation:** Crews follow Interlocking Concrete Pavement Institute specifications.
7. **Ontario One Call locates:** Filed 5+ business days before any excavation (mandatory under Ontario law).
8. **Warranty:** 5-Year Sink & Settlement Warranty on workmanship.

## Lead Process (No-Free-Site-Visit Model)

Golden Maple does not offer free in-person site visits as a top-of-funnel step. Lead progression is:

1. **Online cost estimator** (free, instant, no signup): /cost-estimator — gives ±10–25% range with itemized 5-line breakdown (excavation, materials, labour, disposal, restoration), brand picker, real Simcoe County pricing.
2. **Free 15-minute discovery call** by phone: /book — confirms scope, timeline, budget fit, fit assessment.
3. **$99 paid Design Session** (60 min, on-site or video, credited toward project if client proceeds): material samples, layout sketch, exact pricing — yours to keep.

## Best Time to Install (Ontario)

- **Prime windows:** Late April–early June, and September–mid October
- **Open but busy:** Mid-June through August
- **Closed:** Mid-November through March (no reputable contractor installs in winter)
- **Booking lead time:** 3–6 months for spring; 6–10 weeks for fall
- **Spring 2026 typically books out by:** late February
- See: https://goldenmaplelandscaping.ca/resources/best-time-install-patio-ontario

## Permits & Bylaws Summary

- **Paver patio (ground level, under 60 cm above grade):** No building permit required in Barrie/Simcoe.
- **Retaining wall under 1 metre exposed face height:** No permit; setback rules apply.
- **Retaining wall 1 metre or more:** Building permit + P.Eng-stamped drawings required (Ontario Building Code).
- **Deck attached or over 60 cm:** Building permit required.
- **Outdoor kitchen:** Gas, electrical, and/or plumbing permits required separately.
- **Wood-burning fire pit (Barrie):** Open Air Burning Permit required (By-law 2018-014).
- **Ontario One Call (1-800-400-2255):** MANDATORY before any digging — 5 business days minimum.
- See: https://goldenmaplelandscaping.ca/resources/landscape-permits-barrie-simcoe
